newsitem.title: USA: Telegen says realigns management team.
newsitem.headline: Telegen says realigns management team.

text.p: Telegen Corp said Tuesday that it has realigned its senior management team, naming Warren Dillard as its chief executive officer.
Dillard, the company said in a statement, already serves as the company's chief financial officer.
Telegen named Gilbert Decker, until now an outside director and former assistant secretary of the U.S. Army, as its chairman of the board.
The company also said that Jessica Stevens, the former chairman, president and chief executive officer, will fill a newly created position of president/chief technology officer.
Commenting on the restructuring, it quoted Stevens as saying "This realignment of responsibilities is an important step in our continuing development as an operating company.
"...it is imperative that I move away from day-to-day operations and spend all my time and energy working in the lab with our development teams," she added.
